context_requirements: Functional expression of slow afterhyperpolarization channels (e.g., SK/KCa2 or related calcium-activated potassium channels) in the assayed cell line
Neuronal or excitable-cell lineage or engineered expression of the channel complex
Calcium influx or signaling sufficient to activate the channel
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of a specific transcriptional signature shared across the nine cell lines after treatment
Changes in genes known to be downstream of calcium-activated potassium channel signaling in non-neuronal cells
